subject: Model running in lavaan, not running in blavaan

messages.author: 2d273f6217f6ad4b
messages.subject: Model running in lavaan, not running in blavaan
parts:
Dear all, 

I am trying to run the following script on my meta-analytical data: 

HostPA <- '1,
                    0.511, 1,
                    0.445, 0.601, 1,
                    0.111, 0.101, 0.027, 1,
                    0.07, 0.152, 0.041, 0.519, 1,
                    0.099, 0.144, 0.112, 0.42, 0.535, 1'

HostPA.cor <- getCov(HostPA,names=c("Host1","Host2","Host3","PA1","PA2","PA3"))


HostPA.mod <- '
    PA3 ~ PA2 + Host2
    PA2 ~ PA1 + Host1
    Host3 ~ Host2 + PA2 
    Host2 ~ Host1 + PA1

    PA3 ~~ Host3
    PA2 ~~ Host2
    PA1 ~~ Host1
'
HostPA.fit <- sem(HostPA.mod, sample.cov=HostPA.cor, sample.nobs=6693)
summary(HostPA.fit)

bHostPA.fit <- bsem(HostPA.mod, sample.cov=HostPA.cor, sample.nobs=6693) 

The model runs in lavaan without issues and I get similar results as in metasem. However, it does not run in blavaan. I get the following error: 

Error in apply(dotdotdot$data, 2, function(x) inherits(x, "ordered")) : 
  dim(X) must have a positive length

I'd appreciate any suggestions how to make the model run in blavaan. 

Best, 
Kinga

messages.author: 82889e926eb5165e
messages.subject: Re: Model running in lavaan, not running in blavaan
parts:
the issue is that blavaan does not work with covariance matrix as input, need the row data

You could simulate data from the correlation matrix, and feed that to blavaan

dat_sim <- rockchalk::mvrnorm(n=6693, Sigma = HostPA.cor, mu=rep(0, ncol(HostPA.cor)))


Also, there is a google group for blavaan specific questions

https://groups.google.com/forum/?fromgroups#!forum/blavaan
